contract: Only complete successful raw-buffer results with status 0, null error/signal, empty stderr, strict round-tripping UTF-8 and at most 16384 stdout bytes can match the complete literal v a(sb) 0 with ASCII outer whitespace. Success is fixed WATCH_1 TYPED_EMPTY/count 0/diagnosticOnly true/identityState UNKNOWN. All other ordinary input remains fixed UNKNOWN.

verification.independentBoundarySweep: All 128 ASCII bytes at both outer boundaries, Unicode/BOM/invalid UTF-8, prefixes/trailing/doubled/NUL output, metadata/stderr/cap failures, fixed public shapes and immutability.
verification.attempts: Each suite ran once without failed approach or implementation change.

upstreamBasis.meaning: Independent source inspection supports the selected terse method-call success grammar. This is source-derived, not execution evidence.

limitations: Caller must provide authentic complete capture metadata and raw bytes; complete:true is an assertion, not independent truncation detection.
Normal records only; accessors, proxies, concurrent mutation and false provenance are outside the contract.
Nonempty replies deliberately remain UNKNOWN. CLI error text does not establish unsupported property/interface.
No installed busctl/systemd, capability, D-Bus query, GetUnit object binding, argv, deadline, process capture, transport or host proof.
No role identity, watch coverage, readiness, PC or production upgrade follows a typed-empty diagnostic.
Staging 24-hour, owner-policy and owner-present gates remain separate; PM1-I1 baseline unchanged.
next: Prepare and independently verify the bounded injected typed observer; actual executable/bus capability and operational packaging remain separate gates.
